job.title: System Engineer
job.description:
Job Overview

  • The candidate will act as a key contributor and/or Product Owner, responsible for defining and managing system-level requirements, ensuring alignment with customer expectations, and supporting delivery using Agile methodologies.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop strong domain expertise in automotive systems (Body, Vehicle Access, Seating, Lighting)
  • Analyze customer requirements and translate them into system-level requirements
  • Perform subsystem and feature analysis, including requirement decomposition
  • Manage interfaces across subsystems to ensure seamless integration
  • Develop and maintain system requirements, boundary diagrams, and capability definitions
  • Support system architecture definition and validation activities
  • Use MBSE tools (e.g., MagicDraw) for system modeling and documentation
  • Work in Agile environments (Scrum/SAFe) and participate in sprint ceremonies
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (design, validation, integration)
  • Communicate effectively with stakeholders, including customers and internal teams

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of System Engineering principles
  • Experience in automotive domain (preferably Body systems: Climate, Lighting, Wiper, Washer, Mirrors)
  • Hands-on experience in:
    • System requirements development
    • Boundary diagrams
    • Capability definitions
  • Experience with MagicDraw or similar MBSE tools
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum/SAFe)
  • Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

Good to Have

  • Experience working with OEMs (preferably Ford)
  • Exposure to system integration and validation processes
  • Understanding of end-to-end vehicle systems and architecture

Key Skills

System Engineering, MBSE, MagicDraw, Automotive Systems, Requirement Management, Agile (Scrum/SAFe), System Architecture, Integration, Validation
